title: [ingest] embed() returns 384-float vector or null and NEVER throws; lexical fallback
summary: lib/embed.js wraps transformers.js + all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (ONNX, 384-dim) in-process — no hosted API, no vector DB. Contract: embed() resolves to 384 floats or null on ANY failure, never throws, so callers fall back to lexical scoring (retrieval must never hard-fail). Model cache is pinned under the daemon data dir, NOT node_modules, so it survives reinstalls.
